entries.description: Enable Confluence Zone publisher when 2+ techniques overlap.

Zone touches before it drops out of the actionable opposing-barrier pool (count). Was 2 - a major/breaker/flip zone still being actively retested lost its opposing-barrier status after its 2nd touch, letting a SELL trade through with no real room-check against it (04 Aug 23:31 incident: SL loss reacting off a demand zone the map had correctly been blocking against 10 minutes earlier). Matches min_level_touches (4), which already treats 4 as the significance bar for levels.
When true, Momentum Ride requires velocity aligned with direction.
H1 closed-bar lookback for major structure (weekly/daily range, untested swing H/L, flip zones). Target window ~2.5-4 weeks (300-500 bars).
M15 closed-bar lookback for session structure (Asia/London/NY range, intermediate OB). Target window ~2-3 days (200-300 bars).
M5 closed-bar lookback for entry structure (OB/FVG/micro BOS/retest). Target window is current + previous session (100-150 bars).
